_comment: Declarations in this repo that shadow a webindex export, with why they have not been adopted. A ratchet: entries may leave, never arrive. Anything not listed fails verify-engine-usage, so the next fork is an argued decision rather than a quiet copy. An entry that no longer matches anything also fails, so the list cannot rot. EMPTY as of webindex v1.14.0 — every remaining argument was answered IN the engine (Brand.repoDir / cacheTtlMs / defaultUa / onFetch, a cache body stored beside its metadata, offline+refresh, apiBase on a bare host, canonicalRepoRef, excerptWindows) rather than by adopting a regression. Keep it empty.
